extension.description: Browse movies and TV shows (TMDB), find sources with your installed CocoScrapers, and stream instantly through Real-Debrid. Continue Watching, My List, quality and size limits, one-click best-source play.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on hosts no content. It only searches with the scrapers you installed and plays through your own Real-Debrid account. Use sources you have the right to access.
